en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a market square with a large central fountain. On the fountain stands a statue of a kneeling archer drawing a bow, with animal figures (deer or stag sculptures) at the corners of the basin. The square is lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops with awnings, and people are visible around the fountain. German text is printed at the top identifying the place as Großenhain in Saxony and the market fountain (Marktbrunnen).
